articles.title: ‘ITI students deserve the same respect as IIT students’, says PM Modi
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi emphasized the importance of vocational education at the 5th Kaushal Deekshant Samaroh in Lucknow. He urged society to respect students attending Industrial Training Institutes equally with those in universities.

articles.title: Assam announces Rs 4,000 crore skill development plan to transform ITIs into Centres of Excellence
articles.summary: Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma has outlined an investment plan exceeding Rs 4,000 crore to transform ITIs and strengthen vocational education. The initiatives include a Rs 2,390 crore modernisation programme covering 77 technical institutions, a Rs 1,016 crore Assam Skill University and a Rs 600 crore rural skill network.

articles.title: JKSSB cheating case: 20 accused arrested, including six government employees, as investigation widens
articles.summary: As per reports, 20 people, including six government employees, have been arrested in connection with alleged cheating during the JKSSB Finance Accounts Assistant examination held on November 15. Police said an insider allegedly obtained a question paper from an examination centre, which was photographed and circulated through a Telegram group.

articles.title: Robert Pattinson was paid $1 million to screen test for the upcoming ‘James Bond’ film
articles.summary: Robert Pattinson managed to secure a hefty payment of one million dollars for a nude audition to land the iconic James Bond role. The audition was a bold attempt to replicate a legendary scene from the 1963 classic, ‘From Russia with Love.’ Following numerous casting setbacks, it was director Denis Villeneuve who endorsed Pattinson, recognizing the unique attributes that he believed were ideal for the next James Bond..
